returns.indexes: Indexes assigned to the newly inserted entries.

executeWhitelisted(address,uint256,bytes.details: The organ validates the call against the policy configured for `target + selector` before forwarding the call. Every configured constraint must pass.

params.value: The amount of native token to forward with the call.

returns.result: The raw return data produced by the external call.

params.selector: The function selector keyed by the policy.
params.target: The external contract keyed by the policy.

returns.constraintsLength: The number of parameter constraints configured on the policy.
returns.enabled: Whether the policy exists and is active.
returns.whitelistedAddressesLength: The number of addresses stored in the policy whitelist.

params.index: The position of the constraint inside the policy.
params.selector: The function selector keyed by the policy.
params.target: The external contract keyed by the policy.

returns.constraintType: The type of validation applied to that argument.
returns.exactValue: The exact value used by exact-match constraints.
returns.maxValue: The upper bound used by range constraints.
returns.minValue: The lower bound used by range constraints.
returns.paramIndex: The zero-based calldata argument index constrained by this rule.

params.index: Index of the entry to read.

returns.index: Index of the entry associated with `addr`.

returns.cid: Metadata CID currently attached to the organ.
returns.interfaceId: ERC-165 interface id implemented by the organ.
returns.permissionsLength: Number of permission entries configured on the organ.

params.index: Index of the permission entry to read.

params.cid: Content identifier describing the organ metadata.
params.entries: Initial entries stored on the organ.
params.procedures: Addresses that receive permissions on the organ.
params.trustedForwarder: ERC-2771 forwarder trusted by the organ.

params.candidate: The address to test against the whitelist.
params.selector: The function selector keyed by the policy.
params.target: The external contract keyed by the policy.

returns._0: True if `candidate` belongs to the whitelist associated with the policy.
True if `forwarder` is trusted by this contract.

params.selector: The function selector whose policy should be removed.
params.target: The external contract whose policy should be removed.

params.permissionAddress: Address whose permissions should be removed.

params.index: Index of the entry to replace.

params.newPermission: Address that should receive the permission instead.

setCallPolicy(address,bytes4,(uint8,uint.details: Policies are keyed by `target + selector`. Each policy can constrain calldata arguments with `NONE`, `EXACT`, `RANGE`, `SELF`, or `WHITELISTED_ADDRESS`. The whitelist is only consulted by constraints that use `WHITELISTED_ADDRESS`.

params.constraints: The calldata constraints that must be satisfied to execute the call.
params.target: The external contract the organ may call.
params.whitelistedAddresses: The addresses accepted by whitelist-based constraints.

returns._0: The forwarder allowed to relay signed calls on behalf of users.

params.cid: New content identifier describing the organ.

addEntries((address,string)[]).notice: Append entries to the organ directory.

addPermission(address,bytes2).notice: Grant permissions to one address or procedure.

executeWhitelisted(address,uint256,bytes.notice: Execute an external call that has been approved by a whitelist policy.

getCallPolicy(address,bytes4).notice: Return summary information about a call policy.

getCallPolicyConstraint(address,bytes4,u.notice: Return one parameter constraint of a call policy.

getEntryIndexForAddress(address).notice: Find the index of one entry address.

getOrgan().notice: Return the core summary of the organ.

getPermission(uint256).notice: Return one permission entry by index.

getPermissions(address).notice: Return the permission bitmask assigned to one address.

isCallPolicyWhitelistedAddress(address,b.notice: Check whether an address is present in a call policy whitelist.

isTrustedForwarder(address).notice: Return whether an address is the trusted ERC-2771 forwarder.

removeCallPolicy(address,bytes4).notice: Remove a previously configured external call policy.

removeEntries(uint256[]).notice: Remove entries from the organ directory.

removePermission(address).notice: Remove every permission bit from one address or procedure.

replaceEntry(uint256,(address,string)).notice: Replace one entry at a fixed index.

replacePermission(address,address,bytes2.notice: Replace one permission holder with another.

setCallPolicy(address,bytes4,(uint8,uint.notice: Configure a whitelist policy for an external call path.

trustedForwarder().notice: Return the trusted ERC-2771 forwarder used by this contract.

updateCid(string).notice: Update the metadata CID of the organ.
